cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import numpy as np
x = np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [2.0, 1.0], [3.0, 0.5]])
mass = np.array([5.0, 0.5])
N, M = x.shape
keep = np.ones((N, M), dtype=bool)
hidden = np.where(keep, x, -np.inf)
u = np.sort(hidden, axis=0)[::-1]
cssv = np.cumsum(u, axis=0)
rank = np.repeat(np.arange(1, N+1, dtype=float)[:, np.newaxis], M, axis=1)
cond = (u*rank) > (cssv - mass)[np.newaxis, :]
print('rank', rank.tolist())
print('u*rank', (u*rank).tolist())
print('cssv-mass', (cssv-mass).tolist())
print('cond', cond.tolist())
rho = np.sum(cond, axis=0) - 1
print('rho', rho)
theta = (cssv[rho, np.arange(M)] - mass)/(rho+1.0)
print('theta', theta)
w = np.clip(hidden - theta, 0, None)
print('w', w.tolist())
PYEOF
